Design system

Glowvie

A warm, motion-led system for a skincare studio: coral on blush and cream, Playfair headings over DM Sans, arch photography, and a scroll-reveal layer that makes every section arrive rather than appear.

Coral on blush and cream, charcoal for depth

Coral — the single brand colour

Foundations

Typography

Playfair Display headings · DM Sans interface · micro-caps navigation

The two families

Display

Playfair Display

Weight 500, occasionally 600 for the hero. Every heading, price, quote and stat. Italic 500 is the accent cut — one word per heading, never a full line. Never uppercase.

Interface

DM Sans

400 for body, 500 for labels, buttons and nav. Everything structural: paragraphs, forms, chips, footer links, the micro-caps navigation.

4pt spacing, the arch and blob motifs, three shadows

Spacing — 4pt base, no in-between values

--sp-1 · 4px · icon nudges
--sp-2 · 8px · label to field
--sp-3 · 12px · inside chips and plus tabs
--sp-4 · 16px · button gaps
--sp-5 · 24px · grid gap, stacked text
--sp-6 · 32px · card padding
--sp-7 · 48px · heading to content

--sp-9 · 96px · major break
--sp-10 · 128px · hero breathing room

--section-y (56→112px) sets every section's vertical padding · --gutter (20→48px) the horizontal · --maxw 1240px · prose caps at 60 characters.

Shape — the arch and the blob carry the brand

--r-sm 6px · plus tab

Foundations

Motion

Reveals, stagger, float, marquee, counters, parallax — replayable

The rule

Nothing on a Glowvie page appears — everything arrives. Content fades up as it enters the viewport, siblings arrive in sequence rather than together, decorative shapes never fully settle, and every interactive surface answers within 320ms. Motion is where the brand's warmth lives; it is also the first thing to switch off for anyone who asks, which tokens.css does globally through prefers-reduced-motion.

Easing & duration

--ease-out
.22, 1, .36, 1

Reveals, lifts, translations. Fast start, long settle.

--ease-soft
.4, 0, .2, 1

Colour, opacity, background fills.

--ease-back
.34, 1.4, .64, 1

Plus tabs and chips — a small overshoot.

Durations

180 fast · 320 base · 620 slow · 800 reveal · 90ms stagger step.

1 · Scroll reveal — five entrances, one per element

up
translateY 32
left
translateX −32
right
translateX 32
scale
0.94 → 1
clip
image wipe

Markup is one attribute: <div class="reveal" data-reveal="up">. Each element fires once, when its top edge crosses 88% of the viewport. clip is reserved for photography — it wipes rather than fades.

2 · Stagger — the same reveal, offset 90ms per sibling

01
02
03
04

Wrap the grid in .stagger — the runtime indexes the children and CSS multiplies --i by the step. Never stagger more than six items; past that the last one feels late.

3 · Ambient float — nothing decorative sits still

.float
.float--sm · 5s .float--rev

±9px over 7s, ease-in-out, alternating. Hero shapes, product shots, floating badges and leaves — never text, and never anything clickable at rest.

4 · Marquee — announcement bar and treatment strip

Special offer · 20% off your first facialFree skin consultationOpen Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00 Special offer · 20% off your first facialFree skin consultationOpen Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00

Track duplicated once and translated −50% over 34s, linear, so the loop is seamless. It pauses on hover — an offer nobody can read is not an offer.

5 · Counters — numbers roll up once, on entry

0

Average rating

1.4s, cubic ease-out, thousands separated, decimals preserved. With JavaScript off the final value is what ships in the markup — the number is never missing.

6 · Hover vocabulary — four gestures, nothing else

Lift

Cards rise 4px into --sh-2. Hover this card.

Sweep

Buttons fill from the left.

Hover me

Zoom

scale 1.06 · 620ms

Rotate

The plus tab turns 90°.

+

7 · Parallax — scroll inside the frame

Scroll ↓

The leaf lags behind the content at data-parallax="0.35".

Only 0.15 – 0.4. Anything stronger reads as a rendering glitch rather than depth.

Parallax is for decoration only — never for text, cards or anything a reader has to catch.

Budget

One reveal per element, never nested. No more than three things animating in a viewport at once. Only transform and opacity animate — never width, height, top or margin. The whole runtime is a single 2 KB file, motion.js, and it degrades to plain, visible content when JavaScript or motion is switched off.

The plus tab — opens a service, a gallery image, a FAQ

Rest → hover. 38px square, 6px radius, rotates 90° on --ease-back and flips to charcoal. It is the only square element in the kit.

Rules

One primary per section. Labels are uppercase, 0.1em tracking, two to three words, verb first. Buttons never carry a shadow — the sweep and the 2px lift are the whole feedback. Inline actions use an underlined coral link, not a button.

FAQ

Charcoal active row beside a portrait with a floating contact card

FAQ block

FAQ

Popular questions

Everything clients ask before their first visit, answered plainly.

What types of skincare treatments do you offer?+
Custom facials, deep cleansing, brightening masks, body treatments and makeup application — each planned after a skin analysis rather than picked off a menu.
Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?+
Yes. Every protocol has a fragrance-free, acid-free variant, and we patch test anything new before it goes near your face.
How can I book an appointment?+
Online in about a minute, by phone, or on WhatsApp. First consultations are free and take 30 minutes.
What should I expect during my first visit?+
A consultation, camera analysis, a written plan with costs and downtime, and no pressure to book on the day.
